method: offline Unicorn runs of the original (4,6) slot-3 entry over the memory image with synthetic geom blocks, capsule shapes and kind-6 triangle-mesh shapes (authored grids, steps, flat planes and triangle soups with a conservative 8-bit quantized tree, u16 indices and group keys, edge adjacency, collision-filter objects); return value and all 520 output records (plus a guard) compared byte for byte with engine.pose_narrowphase_capsule_terrain6; input regions must be unchanged; executed blocks must stay in the contact-code region, the stack probe and memcpy
supplied_to_model: 0x1952b20 result: triangle ids captured after each call (0x19cc614, 0x19cc6e1); its AABB argument words and capacity must equal the model query arguments
0x19974c0 result: records and count captured at 0x19cca71/0x19cca76; the records it reads must equal the model records
fixtures: 0x18c9140 / 0x18c8f50 (frame allocator, reaches obfuscated thunks) replaced by ret stubs returning a bump allocation; not traced
global allocator object at 0x1433365b8 with alloc/realloc/free stubs
runtime statics: XYZ mask 0x3336890, 0x3336cb0 {4,8,16,0}, 0x3336cc0 {0x20,0x40,0x80,0}, 0x3336cd0 1/255 x4 (values copied from their initializer sources 0x29cbb90, 0x2900610, 0x29cbba0)
gs:[0x10] stack limit, TLS slot array (as other narrow-phase harnesses)

bug_injections.bug: same-side contacts ignore the remaining capacity
inside-end point B offset always the radius

limits: Synthetic meshes and trees, not game assets; real kind-6 resources (layout of +0x80 trees, group keys, scale, filter tables) may differ.
The tree query 0x1952b20 and mode-2 filter 0x19974c0 are not restated; their native results are supplied.
MXCSR is the Unicorn default 0x1f80; hardware two-NaN choice not observed.
Special lanes only in modes 0/1/3 (mode 2 cases are finite).
